verdict.rationale: Ironclad publishes an extensive, well-documented public REST API (Records, Workflows, Webhooks, Clickwrap, BYOSP) with OAuth 2.0 authentication, client registration, and detailed reference docs, confirmed by probe fetches (llms.txt, docs.md) showing live developer documentation. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent third-party hands-on corroboration of API usage.
